_provenance: Public-literature parasitic values for face-to-face (F2F) hybrid bond contacts. These are OTHER PROCESSES' published numbers — a peer-reviewed design-methodology assumption plus measured bond test structures — NOT Huawei's process data. Citing them does not fire Trigger B (foundry/PDK disclosure for dual-active-logic stacking) or Trigger A (shipping teardown). Their only role is to anchor one corner of the what-if sweep's parasitic bracket to citable sources instead of invented values.
_access_note: Values were verified from published excerpts and secondary coverage; primary PDFs (ACM/IEEE/arXiv) were not directly retrievable from the environment that assembled this file. The citations identify the primary sources so a reviewer can verify independently.

f2f_bond_assumption.source: Hier-3D: A Hierarchical Physical Design Methodology for Face-to-Face-Bonded 3D ICs, ACM ISLPED 2022, DOI 10.1145/3531437.3539702
f2f_bond_assumption.kind: design assumption (peer-reviewed physical-design methodology, not a measurement)
f2f_bond_assumption._quote: In 3D implementations, the F2F via size, pitch, resistance, and capacitance are 0.5 um x 0.5 um, 1.0 um, 0.5 Ohm, and 1 fF, respectively.

datapoints.source: Low-Temperature Cu/SiO2 Hybrid Bonding with Low Contact Resistance Using (111)-Oriented Cu Surfaces, Materials 15(5):1888, 2022
datapoints.note: Reported as the lowest value for Cu-Cu joints bonded below 300 C at publication.

datapoints.source: Efficient Cu/SiO2 hybrid bonding through alkaline surface modification for 3D IC integration, ScienceDirect, 2025
Bonded-copper-interconnect test structures for 3D integration (order-of-magnitude figure reported across multiple studies)

datapoints.value_note: ~50 mOhm per connection at 4 um-diameter DBI Cu plugs (implies ~6.3e-9 Ohm-cm2)
datapoints.source: Advances toward reliable high density Cu-Cu interconnects by Cu-SiO2 direct hybrid bonding (DBI), 2016

consistency_check._note: Hier-3D's assumed 0.5 Ohm at a 0.5 x 0.5 um bond pad implies a specific contact resistance of 0.5 Ohm x 0.25 um^2 = 0.125 Ohm-um^2 = 1.25e-9 Ohm-cm2 — inside the measured range above. The bond RESISTANCE is therefore not the load-bearing uncertainty. The 1 fF bond CAPACITANCE is: in Eq. 2 the R_drv*C_b term turns each bond contact into roughly R_drv femtoseconds of tax (200 fs at R_drv = 200 Ohm), which dwarfs every resistance-side term. Encoded as a unit test in tests/test_literature_fixture.py.
